metadata.title: Canonical Truth Reconciliation, Formal Claim Audit, and Multi-Grade Naturality

canonical_definitions.grade_domain: A_R = Q_bar cap R (field of real algebraic numbers)
canonical_definitions.intrinsic_fiber: F_K = {K} x Z, isomorphic to the ring of integers Z via phi_K: n |-> (K, n)
canonical_definitions.ambient_realization: Phi_K(K, n) = n * tau^K with tau = 2pi
canonical_definitions.canonical_transfer: T_{J <- K}(K, n) = (J, n), ring isomorphism satisfying functoriality and trivial holonomy
canonical_definitions.intrinsic_spectral_object: zeta_K^{int}(s) = sum_{n >= 1} n^(-s) = zeta(s), identically constant across all grades K
canonical_definitions.auxiliary_analytic_pullback: Z_K^{pull}(s) = zeta(tau^(-K) * s); moving zero law rho |-> tau^K * rho belongs ONLY to this auxiliary pullback

source_authority_hierarchy: 1. MATH_CONTRACT.md — Exact accepted mathematical contracts and identities
3. RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS.md — Active conjectural programme and theoretical boundaries
4. RESEARCH_LEDGER.md — Chronological research milestones and discovery logs
5. docs/reviews/* — Task-specific audit packages and reviews
6. Historical research files — Preserved evidence and provenance, not canonical definitions

external_theorem_dependencies.name: Lindemann (1882)
external_theorem_dependencies.scope: Transcendence of pi, e, and log p for rational primes p != 1; injectivity of ev_tau on integer grades Z

external_theorem_dependencies.name: Gelfond-Schneider (1934)
external_theorem_dependencies.scope: Transcendence of a^b for algebraic a != 0, 1 and irrational algebraic b; forces dim_Q S_tau <= 1

loop_holonomy.law: For any closed loop K_0 -> K_1 -> ... -> K_r = K_0, the composite transfer is id_{F_{K_0}}

ambient_scale_cocycle.coboundary_status: Exact 1-coboundary: c(J, K) = g(J)/g(K) with g(K) = tau^K

spectral_grade_cocycle.coboundary_status: Exact 1-coboundary: c_s(J, K) = g_s(J)/g_s(K) with g_s(K) = tau^(-K*s)

natural_observable_theorem.unary_reconstruction: Any transfer-natural observable O_K : F_K -> X satisfies O_K = O_0 o T_{0 <- K}
natural_observable_theorem.r_ary_reconstruction: Any componentwise natural r-ary observable is uniquely determined by its reference grade-0 restriction

simultaneous_dirichlet_compatibility.path_law: Accumulated multiplier along any path equals the direct multiplier
simultaneous_dirichlet_compatibility.zero_divisor_result: Imposing all pairwise compatibility relations D_J(s) = tau^{-(J-K)s} D_K(s) simultaneously is an identity of coboundaries. It preserves Div_0(D) identically and imposes zero additional constraints on zeros or RH.

ambient_realization_kernel_status.definition: ker(ev_tau) = { sum a_j [K_j] in A_R[A_R] : sum a_j tau^{K_j} = 0 }
ambient_realization_kernel_status.rank_one_affine_support: INJECTIVE for K_j = K_0 + q_j * alpha with alpha not in S_tau
ambient_realization_kernel_status.zeta_to_kernel_search_finding: NO_ZETA_TO_REALIZATION_KERNEL_BRIDGE_FOUND (Special values, zero ordinates, prime logs do not produce algebraic relations in ker(ev_tau))

falsification_controls.synthetic_non_coboundary_cocycle: Verified: artificial cocycle with loop product != 1 produces holonomy obstruction; TC scale cocycle is identically 1
falsification_controls.synthetic_grade_dependent_coefficients: Verified: a_{n,K} = n^(K/2) moves zeros to rho + K/2, confirming that genuine coupling can move zeros while unit rescaling preserves them

final_project_verdict.verdict_statement: The simultaneous TC family of algebraic grades is naturally trivial. Canonical transfer compatibility and ambient/spectral grade characters have trivial path dependence and loop holonomy (exact coboundaries). Imposing all pairwise compatibility equations simultaneously does not constrain the common zero divisor beyond single-grade factorability. Current TC axioms contain no demonstrated RH constraint beyond transport and covariance.
